# getOwnerHQ

getOwnerHQ is a Multi-tenant SaaS platform built for Indian gym owners. 

## Features
- Gym Member self-registrations via QR Code
- Dashboard for tracking expiring memberships
- Manual WhatsApp reminders
- Payments Ledger

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Backend/Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
